documents.stance_why: The announcement says Section IV-B "confirms the right of the instructor to specify the permitted use of AI" and the background stresses "Primacy of instructor preference"; the university sets no uniform allow or ban, so the stance is delegates.
documents.summary: A Provost announcement of the draft Academic Integrity Policy Pertaining to AI and its appendices, summarizing sections IV-B to IV-D. It leaves permitted AI use to each instructor, requires citation when AI is allowed, and discourages reliance on AI detectors.

documents.title: Generative AI Guidance (Drexel IT)
documents.stance_why: The page says sensitive data "must not be shared with any of the consumer versions" of GenAI services not reviewed and approved; this bans a use unless the tool is approved but says nothing about student coursework, so restrict is the closest stance.
documents.summary: Drexel IT's guidance addresses data security for generative AI, aimed at faculty and staff. It bars sensitive university data from unapproved consumer GenAI services and describes the review process for new tools.

units.why: The page defines generative AI as technology that "can create text, images, videos, audio, and 3D models based on prompts"; a definition setting what the guidance covers, so P61, informs.
